purpose: Measure whether a reusable security-review pipeline produces validated high/medium signal on one completed public competition scope before any account, submission, wallet, deposit, or live-system action.

excluded: tests, deployments, live contracts, and all non-public systems
findings, fixes, issues, and commits after the competition source commit
selection.selection_reason: The exact historical commit is publicly reproducible, the repository is MIT licensed, the complete scope is only 237 LOC, and an immutable public report contains exactly two adjudicated Medium findings.
selection.source_retrieval: Read-only clone into ignored artifacts/runtime. Pinned imported dependency sources were retrieved only to validate interface/storage semantics; no project code, tests, hooks, dependencies, or build commands executed.

ground_truth.withholding_rule: Do not inspect finding titles, descriptions, issues, fixes, later commits, or the report body until candidate IDs, locations, severities, exploit hypotheses, and confidence are frozen.
ground_truth.contamination: The root agent has observed summary counts and scope metadata only. The selector explicitly withheld finding details; review agents are prohibited from report access.

tracks: Reusable deterministic lexical/invariant inventory with source locations
Root validation and duplicate collapse without report access
candidate_protocol.candidate_minimum: A concrete violated invariant, reachable untrusted action or realistic state transition, material impact, exact source location, and an offline reproduction plan.
candidate_protocol.rejection_default: Speculative, owner-malicious, explicitly accepted-risk, dependency-only, live-state-dependent, or low/informational observations are excluded.
candidate_protocol.freeze_rule: Hash and preserve the candidate artifact before opening the public report.

measurement.primary: validated_precision = report-matched or independently reproducible accepted-equivalent high/medium candidates divided by all frozen candidates
secondary: known-finding recall against the two adjudicated Medium findings
unique accepted-equivalent candidates not present in the report, retained only if reproducible
elapsed analyst time and estimated effective hourly value
measurement.one_scope_continuation_gate: Continue toward ten scopes only if at least one candidate is validated and first-scope precision is at least 25%; otherwise reject or redesign before more replay activity.
measurement.economic_promotion_gate: Across ten scopes require at least two unique accepted-equivalent high/medium findings and estimated return above USD 50/hour before any live participation step.

safety.network_after_retrieval: No source execution or live target access; report retrieval occurs only after candidate freeze.
safety.execution: No project build, test, dependency install, script, deployment, RPC, transaction, or proof against a live system.
safety.credentials_and_capital: No account, KYC, secrets, wallet, deposit, signer, funds, or submission.
safety.disclosure: Only already-public completed-scope material may enter ordinary evidence; any apparently novel issue remains quarantined from external communication.
